1.s: John declares what he has heard, seen and touched: the Word of life. “God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.” “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us.”
1.d: The opening is close to the beginning of John’s Gospel (John 1:1–18) [[tosn:1 John 1:1-4]]. “God is light, and in him is no darkness at all” [[bible:1 John 1:5]]: God is completely pure, good and true [[tosn:1 John 1:5]].

2.s: “If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.” Whoever says he knows God must keep his commands and love his brother. Don’t love the world.
2.d: “Atoning sacrifice” translates the Greek hilasmos, a sacrifice that takes away sin (see 4:10) [[tosn:1 John 2:2]]. Because Christ offered himself for our sins, Christians need not fear confessing their sins to God [[tosn:1 John 2:1]].

3.s: “See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God!” We know love by this: he laid down his life for us. Love in deed and truth.
3.d: “When he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is” [[bible:1 John 3:2]]. Those with this hope keep themselves pure [[tosn:1 John 3:1-3]]. God judges hatred as he judges murder (Matthew 5:21–22) [[tosn:1 John 3:12-13]].

4.s: Test the spirits: every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ came in the flesh is from God. “God is love.” “There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear.” “We love him, because he first loved us.”
4.d: “God is love” [[bible:1 John 4:8]]: God is the source of all love. With “God is light” (1:5) this is the foundation of John’s message [[tosn:1 John 4:8]]. Those who have received God’s love will love others [[tosn:1 John 4:11-12]].

5.s: Faith in Jesus overcomes the world. “God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.” “These things I have written… that you may know that you have eternal life.”
5.d: After “three who testify”, a few very late manuscripts add words about the Father, the Word and the Holy Spirit; they began as an explanation and are not in the early Greek copies [[tosn:1 John 5:7-8]] [[webfn:1 John 5:7]]. See the note before 5:7.
